ai_training_ordre.name: ai_training_ordre
ai_training_ordre.value: "ai_training_progress"."registered_at" IS NULL OR ("ai_training_progress"."passed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_training_progress"."guide_ack_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_training_progress"."certificate_code" IS NOT NULL)

prevention_plans_validation.name: prevention_plans_validation
prevention_plans_validation.value: "prevention_plans"."status" NOT IN ('validated', 'replaced') OR "prevention_plans"."validated_at" IS NOT NULL

reports_validation_complete.name: reports_validation_complete
reports_validation_complete.value:
"reports"."status" <> 'validated' OR (
        "reports"."check_sources_verified" AND "reports"."check_no_small_group"
        AND "reports"."check_language_rule" AND "reports"."check_limits_mentioned"
        AND "reports"."validated_by" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."validated_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "reports"."final_text" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("reports"."final_text")) > 0
      )

users_role_coherent.name: users_role_coherent
users_role_coherent.value:
("users"."role" = 'admin' AND "users"."organization_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("users"."role" = 'referent' AND "users"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."password_hash" IS NULL)

workshop_registrations_textes.name: workshop_registrations_textes
workshop_registrations_textes.value: length("workshop_registrations"."name") BETWEEN 2 AND 120 AND length("workshop_registrations"."email") <= 254 AND "workshop_registrations"."email" = lower(trim("workshop_registrations"."email"))

workshops_textes.name: workshops_textes
workshops_textes.value: length("workshops"."title") BETWEEN 3 AND 120 AND coalesce(length("workshops"."description"), 0) <= 1000 AND length("workshops"."place") BETWEEN 2 AND 300 AND coalesce(length("workshops"."facilitator"), 0) <= 120

workshops_action.name: workshops_action
workshops_action.value: "workshops"."plan_action_id" IS NULL OR "workshops"."plan_id" IS NOT NULL
